title: hieracium ctenodon subsp. largatum
intro: Hieracium ctenodon subsp. largatum, commonly known as a species of hawkweed, is a flowering plant in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium ctenodon subsp. largatum include wound healing, antiseptic, and antiviral activities, making it a potential remedy for skin conditions and infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
